# @lowcoai/workflow full specification

## Package

- Name: `@lowcoai/workflow`
- Language: TypeScript
- Entrypoint: `src/index.ts`
- Runtime requirement: Fetch API available (Node 18+ or browser) or custom `fetch` injected

## Root client

```ts
class WorkflowClient {
  readonly workflows: WorkflowsResource;
  readonly environments: EnvironmentsResource;
  readonly functions: FunctionsResource;
  readonly executions: ExecutionsResource;
  readonly activities: ActivitiesResource;
  readonly humanTasks: HumanTasksResource;
  readonly analytics: AnalyticsResource;
  readonly dryRun: DryRunResource;
  readonly webhooks: WebhooksResource;
}
```

Access pattern:

- `const client = new WorkflowClient(config)`
- `client.workflows.list(...)`

## Configuration

```ts
interface SDKConfig {
  token: string;   // required; user token or API key, becomes Authorization: Bearer <token>
  orgId?: string;  // becomes X-Org-Id
  timeoutMs?: number; // default 30000
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  fetch?: typeof globalThis.fetch;
}
// All requests go to https://api.lowco.ai
```

## Error model

- Throws `WorkflowError`
  - `status`: HTTP status code (`0` for transport/setup errors and for the deprecated webhook methods, which send no request)
  - `payload`: parsed JSON payload when available

## Response model

- If server returns envelope object with `data`, SDK returns `data`
- Otherwise SDK returns full parsed response payload

## Resources and methods

### workflows

- `list(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows`
- `count(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows/count`
- `getById(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows/:id`
- `create(payload)` -> `POST /v1/wf/workflows`
- `update(id, payload)` -> `PUT /v1/wf/workflows/:id`
- `delete(id)` -> `DELETE /v1/wf/workflows/:id`
- `run(payload)` -> `POST /v1/wf/workflows/run`
- `versions(id, query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows/:id/versions`
- `publish(id, payload)` -> `POST /v1/wf/workflows/:id/publish`
- `published(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows/published`
- `publishedCount(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows/published/count`
- `getPublishedById(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows/published/:id`
- `updatePublished(id, payload)` -> `PUT /v1/wf/workflows/published/:id`
- `deletePublished(id)` -> `DELETE /v1/wf/workflows/published/:id`
- `webPublished(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows/published/web`
- `webPublishedById(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows/published/web/:id`
- `searchPublishedTemplates({ q?, category?, limit? })` -> `GET /v1/wf/workflows/published/web/search`

Run semantics:

- Start execution: include `workflowId`
- Resume execution: include `workflowId`, `executionId`, and `activityId`

### environments

- `list(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/environments`
- `getById(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/environments/:id`
- `create(payload)` -> `POST /v1/wf/environments`
- `update(id, payload)` -> `PUT /v1/wf/environments/:id`
- `delete(id)` -> `DELETE /v1/wf/environments/:id`
- `setDefault(id)` -> `PATCH /v1/wf/environments/:id/default`

### functions

- `list(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/functions`
- `getById(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/functions/:id`
- `create(payload)` -> `POST /v1/wf/functions`
- `update(id, payload)` -> `PUT /v1/wf/functions/:id`
- `delete(id)` -> `DELETE /v1/wf/functions/:id`
- `versions(id, query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/functions/:id/versions`
- `execute(id, params?)` -> `POST /v1/wf/functions/:id/execute`

### executions

- `list(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/executions`
- `count(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/executions/count`
- `getById(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/executions/:id`
- `logs(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/executions/:id/logs`

### activities

- `list(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/activities`
- `count(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/activities/count`
- `getById(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/activities/:id`
- `logs(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/activities/:id/logs`

### humanTasks

- `list(query?)` -> `GET /v1/wf/human-tasks`
- `getById(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/human-tasks/:id`
- `complete(id, action)` -> `PATCH /v1/wf/human-tasks/:id/complete`

### analytics

- `default()` -> `GET /v1/wf/analytics`
- `getById(id)` -> `GET /v1/wf/analytics/:id`

### dryRun

- `execute(payload)` -> `POST /v1/wf/dryrun`

Payload:

```ts
{
  executionId: string;
  expression: string;
  typeOfExpression: "object" | "string" | "statement" | "map";
  activityId: string;
}
```

### webhooks

- `trigger(workflowId, payload?, query?)` -> `POST /v1/wf/webhook/:id`
  - Runs the workflow with `payload` as its input
  - Query: `env`, `triggeredBy`, `async`

Deprecated, do not use. The workflow API serves only the trigger route, and webhook registration is handled by the integrations service. Each method below rejects with `WorkflowError` (`status: 0`, `payload: { code: "unsupported_operation", operation }`) and sends no request:

- `listByWorkflow(workflowId)`
- `create(workflowId, payload)`. It used to POST to the trigger route, so it ran the workflow with the webhook config as input.
- `update(webhookId, payload)`
- `delete(workflowId)`

## Core exported types

- `Workflow`, `WorkflowUpdateRequest`, `RunWorkflowRequest`
- `Environment`, `Variable`
- `FunctionEntity`, `FunctionVersionRequest`
- `Execution`, `ActivityExecutionHistory`, `ActivityHistoryResponse`
- `HumanTask`, `HumanTaskAction`
- `WorkflowPublish`
- `DryRunRequest`, `WebhookCreateRequest` (deprecated, used only by the deprecated webhook methods)
- `PaginationQuery`, `RequestOptions`

## Suggested deployment for LLM consumption

- Host `README.md`, `llms.txt`, and `llms-full.txt` at stable URLs
- Keep method names and endpoint routes unchanged between releases when possible
- Include semantic version in docs and changelog
